import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# 连接到SQLite数据库
db_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# 引擎A：SQL计算
query = """
SELECT AVG(total_invoice_amount) AS avg_a,
       SUM(total_invoice_amount) AS sum_a,
       COUNT(total_invoice_amount) AS cnt_a,
       COUNT(*) AS total_a
FROM quickbooks__customer_analytics
"""
result_a = conn.execute(query).fetchone()
avg_a, sum_a, cnt_a, total_a = result_a

print("引擎A (SQL) 计算结果:")
print(f"平均值: {avg_a}")
print(f"总和: {sum_a}")
print(f"非空值计数: {cnt_a}")
print(f"总行数: {total_a}")

# 引擎B：Pandas计算
df = pd.read_sql("SELECT total_invoice_amount FROM quickbooks__customer_analytics", conn)

# 转换数据类型确保一致
df['total_invoice_amount'] = df['total_invoice_amount'].astype(float)

# 检查NULL/NaN处理
print(f"\nPandas数据信息:")
print(f"数据形状: {df.shape}")
print(f"数据类型: {df['total_invoice_amount'].dtype}")
print(f"非空值数量: {df['total_invoice_amount'].count()}")
print(f"NaN值数量: {df['total_invoice_amount'].isna().sum()}")

# 计算指标
if df.empty:
    avg_b = sum_b = np.nan
    cnt_b = total_b = 0
else:
    # 显式处理NaN以确保一致性
    avg_b = df['total_invoice_amount'].mean(skipna=True)
    sum_b = df['total_invoice_amount'].sum(skipna=True)
    cnt_b = df['total_invoice_amount'].count()
    total_b = len(df)

print("\n引擎B (Pandas) 计算结果:")
print(f"平均值: {avg_b}")
print(f"总和: {sum_b}")
print(f"非空值计数: {cnt_b}")
print(f"总行数: {total_b}")

# 比较结果
print("\n=== 结果比较 ===")

# 定义比较函数
def compare_values(val_a, val_b, metric_name):
    if pd.isna(val_a) and pd.isna(val_b):
        print(f"{metric_name}: 双方均为NaN - 匹配 ✓")
        return True
    elif pd.isna(val_a) or pd.isna(val_b):
        print(f"{metric_name}: 一方为NaN - 不匹配 ✗ (A: {val_a}, B: {val_b})")
        return False
    elif abs(val_a - val_b) < 1e-10:
        print(f"{metric_name}: 完全匹配 ✓ (A: {val_a}, B: {val_b})")
        return True
    else:
        print(f"{metric_name}: 不匹配 ✗ (A: {val_a}, B: {val_b}, 差异: {abs(val_a - val_b):.10e})")
        return False

# 比较所有指标
matches = [
    compare_values(avg_a, avg_b, "平均值"),
    compare_values(sum_a, sum_b, "总和"),
    compare_values(cnt_a, cnt_b, "非空值计数"),
    compare_values(total_a, total_b, "总行数")
]

if all(matches):
    print("\n✅ 所有指标完全匹配！引擎A和引擎B结果一致。")
else:
    print("\n❌ 存在差异，需要进一步调试。")
    
    # 调试：查看数据前几行
    print("\n=== 数据检查 ===")
    print("SQL查询前5行:")
    df_sample = pd.read_sql("SELECT total_invoice_amount FROM quickbooks__customer_analytics LIMIT 5", conn)
    print(df_sample)
    
    print("\n数据描述统计:")
    print(df['total_invoice_amount'].describe())
    
    # 重新检查SQL NULL处理
    print("\n=== SQL NULL检查 ===")
    null_check = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN total_invoice_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN total_invoice_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS not_null_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM quickbooks__customer_analytics
    """, conn)
    print(null_check)

conn.close()

print("\n=== 任务完成 ===")
print("引擎A和引擎B已计算并比较，如有差异已显示详细信息。")
```
